items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: The interviewee does not speak; the interviewer mentions 'Sheik' and states 'Sheik used to play with my husband.'

ctx.x: That's not John Lee Wiggs. It must be. It might be. John Lee Wiggs. Somebody say something like John. He'd be with a fellow that called Chris. A white fellow that called Chris from the French Quarter. Do you know him? They got band music. They go through. You know, um... Sheik. Yeah.
I know Sheik. Well, Sheik. She knows them all. Sheik knows them. Yeah.
I know. I know. I know.
